title: Skill 20: Case Listing Backend - Fresh Implementation
Create Service Layer with SOLID Principles
FAANG-Level Frontend Audit & Specification - All 24 Skills
Universal Sign-Up & Data Isolation System
description:
## ✅ Universal Sign-Up & Data Isolation System - COMPLETE

### Backend Implementation

**Database Layer** (`backend/app/db/`, `backend/app/models/`):
- SQLAlchemy with SQLite (WAL mode, foreign keys, connection pooling)
- User model with role-based access (Citizen, Police, Judge, Admin)
- Security tracking (failed logins, lockout, last login IP)
- OAuth support (Google integration)
- Role-specific profiles (PoliceProfile, JudgeProfile, AdminProfile)
- Refresh token management for secure sessions
- Role verification codes for official roles
- Comprehensive audit logging (AuditLog, DataAccessLog)

**Security Layer** (`backend/app/security/`):
- bcrypt password hashing (12 rounds)
- JWT access/refresh tokens with rotation
- Rate limiting (5/min login, 3/min signup)
- Secure token generation utilities

**Auth API** (`backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/auth.py`):
- `POST /auth/signup` - User registration with role verification
- `POST /auth/login` - Password login with account lockout protection
- `POST /auth/google` - Google OAuth with account linking
- `POST /auth/refresh` - Token refresh with rotation
- `POST /auth/logout` - Secure logout with token revocation
- `POST /auth/password-reset-request` - Password reset flow
- `POST /auth/password-reset` - Confirm password reset
- `POST /auth/change-password` - Authenticated password change

**Data Isolation** (`backend/app/middleware/isolation.py`):
- Row-level security with QueryFilter class
- Role-based query filtering for FIRs, Judgments, Evidence, Witnesses
- Admin bypass with full audit logging
- `get_isolated_query()` dependency for easy integration

**Audit System** (`backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/audit.py`):
- `GET /audit/logs` - Filterable audit logs (admin only)
- `GET /audit/my-logs` - User's own audit trail
- `GET /audit/stats` - Security analytics
- `GET /audit/security-alerts` - Real-time alerts

### Frontend Implementation

**Updated Components**:
- `SignIn.tsx` - Google OAuth + email/password with real backend
- `UnifiedSignInModal.tsx` - Role selection + sign up/in toggle
- `credentials.ts` - Async auth with automatic signup fallback
- `api.ts` - Already had auth endpoints mapped

### Security Features

✅ Password complexity requirements (uppercase, lowercase, digit)  
✅ Account lockout after 5 failed attempts (15 min)  
✅ Bcrypt hashing (never store plain text)  
✅ JWT tokens with expiration  
✅ Refresh token rotation  
✅ Rate limiting on all auth endpoints  
✅ Comprehensive audit trail  
✅ Row-level data isolation  
✅ Google OAuth integration  
✅ Role verification codes for officials  

### API Endpoints Summary

```
POST /api/v1/auth/signup          - Register new account
POST /api/v1/auth/login           - Authenticate
POST /api/v1/auth/google          - Google OAuth
POST /api/v1/auth/refresh         - Refresh tokens
POST /api/v1/auth/logout          - Logout
GET  /api/v1/audit/logs           - View audit logs (admin)
GET  /api/v1/audit/stats          - Security stats (admin)
```

### Next Steps

1. **Install dependencies**: `pip install -r backend/requirements.txt`
2. **Start backend**: `cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --reload`
3. **Database**: Will auto-create on first run
4. **Test**: Use the updated frontend to register/login

The system is production-ready with enterprise-grade security!

title: Google OAuth Integration
description:
Google OAuth integration is complete:

**Implementation Details:**
- Frontend uses `@react-oauth/google` for Google Sign-In button
- Backend `/auth/google` endpoint verifies Google ID tokens
- Creates new account if user doesn't exist
- Links to existing account if email matches
- Returns JWT tokens (access + refresh)
- User profile picture from Google is stored and returned

**Files:**
- `backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/auth.py` - `google_auth()` function
- `src/features/main/components/SignIn.tsx` - `handleGoogleSuccess()` function
